correctness.rationale: The actual frozen RESULT.md defines the ordinary generalized Mycielski graph layer by layer, including ell=0 and the apex, and the integral augmentation lattice U_n. Cr_n independence complex is two part simplices joined by n matching bridges: H1 is U_n, and part interchange reverses bridge orientations. The Kronecker double cover of a bipartite graph is two disjoint copies, so its independence complex is the join I*I, with homology U_n tensor U_n in degree three and unsigned tensor flip on swapping the two join factors (two local negative bridge signs cancel). The proof performs full-layer equivariant foldings of the apex deletion and apex closed-neighborhood deletion, establishes the three-period A_ell/B_ell patterns and applies the equivariant Mayer-Vietoris long exact sequence; each term occupies isolated degrees, with no integral extension. For ell=0 the isolated apex gives H~0=Z, H~1=U_n, explicitly handling the boundary. The tensor-flip trace tr((M⊗M)flip)=tr(M^2) produces v(sigma)=fix(sigma^2)-1; the outer unpaired U_n contributes -u(sigma). Independent direct automorphism-invariant independence-set Lefschetz calculations checked 180 small parameter/group cases. Finite verification supports, but cannot prove, the unrestricted integral fold argument.
